title: Weird Cats: pixel-art collection launch
summary: A 54 s launch trailer for a pixel-art cat collection and its website. It boots like a terminal ('> LOADING REALITY...', 'REALITY CHECK: [TOO NORMAL]', progress bar), opens a rainbow pixel portal over a synthwave grid, then walks through the dark website UI, slams full-colour character cards (lime '25 CODEX PETS', 'HYPNO', 'PRISM', 'SMOKE', 'ORBIT'), a grid of all 25, a pixel city, a fake 'Weirdlist opens soon' dialog and an arcade, closing on the logo. Playful, glitchy, internet-native.
fit_reason: The terminal boot-up opener and 'walk the real website' structure are reusable, but pixel art, glitch and neon rainbow are far from a calm premium B2B look.
